title: GDPR
summary: General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) — EU regulation on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.
sources: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Official Journal of the European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj
body_markdown:
# GDPR

## Scope

Processing of personal data in the EU/EEA and of EU data subjects; applicable since 25 May 2018.

## Requirements

Architecture-relevant principles (paraphrased): lawfulness, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality, accountability; data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability); data protection by design and by default.

## Applicability

Any data architecture processing personal data; strongly affects history, retention, immutable logs and copies.
